result.summary: Authored a single new evidence artifact, docs/validation/evidence/buildings-component-validation-2026-09-20/author-owner.patch, containing one unified diff that modifies only godot/scripts/core/buildings.gd by appending after the existing `_refuse_section_1_code()` tail (all prior bytes untouched, no deletions, no reflow). Acknowledging ADR 0183 / BUILDINGS-S4-VALIDATE-R01 v1, the appended code adds: (1) the seventeen REFUSE_COLUMN_* codes (SHAPE, FLAG, and enum/value/ref/free/state for building, room and furniture); (2) the seven frozen immutable fact arrays named in the contract — COLUMN_BUILDING_KEYS, COLUMN_BUILDING_FOOTPRINT_X/Z (30 each), COLUMN_FURNITURE_KEYS, COLUMN_FURNITURE_FLOOR_X/Z (9 each) and COLUMN_TIER_TWO_TYPE_IDS=[5,12,23,29] — with contents matching frozen-source-facts.json and no BuildingDefinitions instantiation; (3) an inner `Columns` class holding the 29 typed packed columns in canonical schema order with `_init(allocate_defaults: bool = true)` that returns before any resize or fill when false (leaving all members empty typed arrays) and otherwise builds the exact clear image with the seven -1 columns filled, plus `is_sized()` checking all 29 exact extents through three bounded helpers; (4) the pure static `columns_refusal(image)` and its static helpers, ordered shape -> four full canonical flag scans in the fixed b_present/r_present/f_present/r_valid order -> ascending building rows -> room rows -> furniture rows, each row applying enum, value, reference, never-used and present-state gates in that order. Retired rows keep history (buildings may retain a nonnull structural construction reference; retired rooms keep parent/type/temperature/occupants with valid 0 and offset/count/mask 0; retired furniture keeps parent/type/geometry/condition with a null user), present zero-user-slot furniture may carry a user, tier 1 is legal for every valid type with tier 2 restricted to ids 5/12/23/29, rotated footprints are bounds-checked before any fact indexing and 0x0 edge footprints claim no tile. References are structural only; no cross-section self identity, liveness or mask equality is asserted. The predicate performs no writes, no live constructors, no callbacks, clock reads, diagnostics, floats, per-row objects or packed scratch, and existing constants/preloads (capacities, TILE_COUNT, MAP_TILES_X/Z, ROOM_TILE_LINK_CAPACITY, ROTATION_COUNT, STATE_COUNT, ROOM_TYPE_COUNT, FURNITURE_KIND_COUNT, NO_LINK, NO_INTERIOR, EntityDirectory and BuildingDefinitions constants) are reused rather than re-aliased. No gameplay behaviour, existing API, schema or codec coupling is touched; no bridge, test, doc or full-file rewrite is included. The patch body is 442 changed/context lines within the hunk, well inside the 650 hard limit. Nothing here was run, applied or verified.

files.content:
--- a/godot/scripts/core/buildings.gd
+++ b/godot/scripts/core/buildings.gd
@@ -1699,4 +1699,442 @@
 func _refuse_section_1_code(code: StringName, detail: String) -> StringName:
 	"""Record one §1 column refusal's detail and hand the code straight back to a `return`."""
 	_section_1_detail = "%s: %s" % [code, detail]
 	return code
+
+
+# --- §4 COLUMN IMAGE: the cold typed columns and their pure ordered predicate --------------------
+#
+# BUILDINGS-S4-VALIDATE-R01 v1, ADR 0183. Owner 0 `buildings`, schema version 1: a 1024-row
+# primary extent, two child extents -- 16384 rooms and 81920 furniture -- and 29 fields whose
+# ORDINALS COME FROM THE SCHEMA, never from this file's declaration order, which also groups the
+# private link and reference columns the save image does not carry at all.
+#
+# BORROWED, NOT COPIED. `Columns.new(false)` returns before a single resize, so a framed caller
+# assigns the 29 views it already holds instead of allocating a second 3298304-byte image beside
+# the one it is checking. `Columns.new()` is the fully sized clear image: seven columns of -1 and
+# every other byte zero.
+#
+# `columns_refusal()` IS PURE -- no live constructor, directory, clock, callback, diagnostic,
+# float, per-row object or packed scratch. Every reference is checked STRUCTURALLY, never
+# resolved: self identity, parent liveness, kind, mask equality, tile-map reciprocity and
+# footprint overlap are sections 1 and 5, and BUILDINGS-SAVED-BINDINGS is what joins them.
+#
+# NEVER-USED IS NOT RETIRED. A never-used building row is the exact clear row, recognised by
+# tier 0; a retired one keeps its tier, type and geometry and MAY still carry a stale
+# construction reference. A retired room keeps its parent, type, temperature and occupants but
+# clears its tile span, mask and validity; retired furniture keeps everything but its user.
+# Present furniture MAY carry a user where the catalog gives it zero user slots: today's public
+# setter permits exactly that, and occupancy policy is not a loader's to refuse.
+
+## ADR 0183's seventeen column refusal codes: a shape gate, a canonical-flag gate, and five
+## ordered gates -- enum, value, reference, never-used and present-state -- per row domain.
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_SHAPE: StringName = &"COLUMN_SHAPE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAG: StringName = &"COLUMN_FLAG"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_ENUM: StringName = &"COLUMN_BUILDING_ENUM"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_VALUE: StringName = &"COLUMN_BUILDING_VALUE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_REF: StringName = &"COLUMN_BUILDING_REF"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_FREE: StringName = &"COLUMN_BUILDING_FREE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_STATE: StringName = &"COLUMN_BUILDING_STATE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_ENUM: StringName = &"COLUMN_ROOM_ENUM"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_VALUE: StringName = &"COLUMN_ROOM_VALUE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_REF: StringName = &"COLUMN_ROOM_REF"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_FREE: StringName = &"COLUMN_ROOM_FREE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_STATE: StringName = &"COLUMN_ROOM_STATE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_ENUM: StringName = &"COLUMN_FURNITURE_ENUM"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_VALUE: StringName = &"COLUMN_FURNITURE_VALUE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_REF: StringName = &"COLUMN_FURNITURE_REF"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_FREE: StringName = &"COLUMN_FURNITURE_FREE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_STATE: StringName = &"COLUMN_FURNITURE_STATE"
+
+## The immutable source facts this predicate indexes, derived by canonical catalog ID and frozen
+## in frozen-source-facts.json. No BuildingDefinitions instance is constructed to obtain a
+## footprint, and nothing here allocates per row.
+const COLUMN_BUILDING_KEYS: Array[String] = [
+	"apiary", "boathouse", "brewery", "cellar", "composter", "covered_store",
+	"dirt_path", "dryer", "fence", "fisher_shelter", "forester_lodge", "gate",
+	"hall", "infirmary", "kitchen", "lookout", "memorial_garden", "mill",
+	"nursery", "open_stockpile", "paved_path", "preserver", "quarry_shed", "residence",
+	"saltpan", "stone_wall", "weir", "well", "workbench", "workshop",
+]
+
+const COLUMN_BUILDING_FOOTPRINT_X: Array[int] = [
+	3, 6, 5, 6, 3, 6, 1, 4, 1, 4, 4, 2, 12, 8, 6,
+	2, 4, 5, 4, 4, 1, 5, 4, 10, 4, 1, 4, 2, 3, 6,
+]
+
+const COLUMN_BUILDING_FOOTPRINT_Z: Array[int] = [
+	3, 4, 4, 6, 3, 6, 1, 3, 1, 3, 4, 1, 10, 8, 6,
+	2, 4, 5, 4, 4, 1, 4, 4, 8, 4, 1, 2, 2, 3, 6,
+]
+
+const COLUMN_FURNITURE_KEYS: Array[String] = [
+	"bed", "decoration", "hearth", "interior_door", "interior_partition",
+	"kitchen_bench", "patient_bed", "seat", "shelf",
+]
+
+const COLUMN_FURNITURE_FLOOR_X: Array[int] = [1, 1, 2, 0, 0, 2, 1, 1, 1]
+const COLUMN_FURNITURE_FLOOR_Z: Array[int] = [1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1]
+
+## BAL-CAT-006's four upgradable keys as compiled BuildingDefinition ids: covered_store 5,
+## hall 12, residence 23 and workshop 29. No other type may be stored at tier 2.
+const COLUMN_TIER_TWO_TYPE_IDS: Array[int] = [5, 12, 23, 29]
+
+
+class Columns:
+	"""One cold, typed image of the 29 saved Building/Room/Furniture columns, in schema order.
+
+	`allocate_defaults` false returns before any resize or fill, leaving all 29 members as the
+	empty typed arrays their initializers give them -- the borrowed-buffer path, which exists
+	only for framed validation and constructs no Buildings, Definitions or Directory. True
+	builds the normal fully sized clear image. `is_sized()` is the only shape authority: an
+	unbound or wrongly sized view is refused COLUMN_SHAPE before any value is read.
+	"""
+
+	var b_present: PackedByteArray = PackedByteArray()
+	var r_present: PackedByteArray = PackedByteArray()
+	var f_present: PackedByteArray = PackedByteArray()
+	var b_type_id: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var b_tier: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var b_origin_tile: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var b_rotation: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var b_state: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var b_condition: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var b_construction_slot: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var b_construction_generation: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var b_interior_id: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var r_type: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var r_building_slot: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var r_building_generation: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var r_tile_offset: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var r_tile_count: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var r_temperature_tenths: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var r_furniture_mask: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var r_occupants: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var r_valid: PackedByteArray = PackedByteArray()
+	var f_type_id: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var f_room_slot: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var f_room_generation: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var f_origin_tile: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var f_rotation: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var f_user_slot: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var f_user_generation: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var f_condition: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+
+	func _init(allocate_defaults: bool = true) -> void:
+		"""Leave every column an empty typed array, or allocate the fully sized clear image.
+
+		`false` returns BEFORE any resize or fill, so a borrowed-buffer caller can assign its own
+		already-shaped views over these members without paying for a second owner image.
+		"""
+		if not allocate_defaults:
+			return
+		_allocate_building_defaults()
+		_allocate_room_defaults()
+		_allocate_furniture_defaults()
+
+	func _allocate_building_defaults() -> void:
+		"""Size the presence flag and the nine i32 Building columns, and fill the -1 ones."""
+		b_present.resize(BUILDING_CAPACITY)
+		b_type_id.resize(BUILDING_CAPACITY)
+		b_tier.resize(BUILDING_CAPACITY)
+		b_origin_tile.resize(BUILDING_CAPACITY)
+		b_rotation.resize(BUILDING_CAPACITY)
+		b_state.resize(BUILDING_CAPACITY)
+		b_condition.resize(BUILDING_CAPACITY)
+		b_construction_slot.resize(BUILDING_CAPACITY)
+		b_construction_generation.resize(BUILDING_CAPACITY)
+		b_interior_id.resize(BUILDING_CAPACITY)
+		b_origin_tile.fill(NO_LINK)
+		b_construction_slot.fill(EntityDirectory.NULL_SLOT)
+		b_interior_id.fill(NO_INTERIOR)
+
+	func _allocate_room_defaults() -> void:
+		"""Size the two flags and the eight i32 Room columns; only the parent slot clears to -1."""
+		r_present.resize(ROOM_CAPACITY)
+		r_type.resize(ROOM_CAPACITY)
+		r_building_slot.resize(ROOM_CAPACITY)
+		r_building_generation.resize(ROOM_CAPACITY)
+		r_tile_offset.resize(ROOM_CAPACITY)
+		r_tile_count.resize(ROOM_CAPACITY)
+		r_temperature_tenths.resize(ROOM_CAPACITY)
+		r_furniture_mask.resize(ROOM_CAPACITY)
+		r_occupants.resize(ROOM_CAPACITY)
+		r_valid.resize(ROOM_CAPACITY)
+		r_building_slot.fill(EntityDirectory.NULL_SLOT)
+
+	func _allocate_furniture_defaults() -> void:
+		"""Size the presence flag and the eight i32 Furniture columns, and fill the -1 ones."""
+		f_present.resize(FURNITURE_CAPACITY)
+		f_type_id.resize(FURNITURE_CAPACITY)
+		f_room_slot.resize(FURNITURE_CAPACITY)
+		f_room_generation.resize(FURNITURE_CAPACITY)
+		f_origin_tile.resize(FURNITURE_CAPACITY)
+		f_rotation.resize(FURNITURE_CAPACITY)
+		f_user_slot.resize(FURNITURE_CAPACITY)
+		f_user_generation.resize(FURNITURE_CAPACITY)
+		f_condition.resize(FURNITURE_CAPACITY)
+		f_room_slot.fill(EntityDirectory.NULL_SLOT)
+		f_origin_tile.fill(NO_LINK)
+		f_user_slot.fill(EntityDirectory.NULL_SLOT)
+
+	func is_sized() -> bool:
+		"""True only when all 29 columns carry exactly their canonical extents."""
+		return _sized_buildings() and _sized_rooms() and _sized_furniture()
+
+	func _sized_buildings() -> bool:
+		"""The presence flag and the nine i32 Building columns, 1024 rows each."""
+		return (b_present.size() == BUILDING_CAPACITY
+			and b_type_id.size() == BUILDING_CAPACITY
+			and b_tier.size() == BUILDING_CAPACITY
+			and b_origin_tile.size() == BUILDING_CAPACITY
+			and b_rotation.size() == BUILDING_CAPACITY
+			and b_state.size() == BUILDING_CAPACITY
+			and b_condition.size() == BUILDING_CAPACITY
+			and b_construction_slot.size() == BUILDING_CAPACITY
+			and b_construction_generation.size() == BUILDING_CAPACITY
+			and b_interior_id.size() == BUILDING_CAPACITY)
+
+	func _sized_rooms() -> bool:
+		"""The two Room flags and its eight i32 columns, 16384 rows each."""
+		return (r_present.size() == ROOM_CAPACITY
+			and r_type.size() == ROOM_CAPACITY
+			and r_building_slot.size() == ROOM_CAPACITY
+			and r_building_generation.size() == ROOM_CAPACITY
+			and r_tile_offset.size() == ROOM_CAPACITY
+			and r_tile_count.size() == ROOM_CAPACITY
+			and r_temperature_tenths.size() == ROOM_CAPACITY
+			and r_furniture_mask.size() == ROOM_CAPACITY
+			and r_occupants.size() == ROOM_CAPACITY
+			and r_valid.size() == ROOM_CAPACITY)
+
+	func _sized_furniture() -> bool:
+		"""The presence flag and the eight i32 Furniture columns, 81920 rows each."""
+		return (f_present.size() == FURNITURE_CAPACITY
+			and f_type_id.size() == FURNITURE_CAPACITY
+			and f_room_slot.size() == FURNITURE_CAPACITY
+			and f_room_generation.size() == FURNITURE_CAPACITY
+			and f_origin_tile.size() == FURNITURE_CAPACITY
+			and f_rotation.size() == FURNITURE_CAPACITY
+			and f_user_slot.size() == FURNITURE_CAPACITY
+			and f_user_generation.size() == FURNITURE_CAPACITY
+			and f_condition.size() == FURNITURE_CAPACITY)
+
+
+# --- the pure ordered predicate: shape, canonical flags, then ascending rows ---------------------
+
+static func columns_refusal(image: Columns) -> StringName:
+	"""The first refusal this image earns in contract order, or REFUSE_NONE.
+
+	Shape first, then all four canonical flag buffers in the fixed order b_present, r_present,
+	f_present, r_valid, then ascending building rows, ascending room rows and ascending furniture
+	rows, each row using its own enum/value/reference/never-used/state gates.
+	"""
+	if image == null or not image.is_sized():
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_SHAPE
+	var flags: StringName = _columns_flag_refusal(image)
+	if flags != REFUSE_NONE:
+		return flags
+	for row: int in BUILDING_CAPACITY:
+		var b_code: StringName = _columns_building_refusal(image, row)
+		if b_code != REFUSE_NONE:
+			return b_code
+	for row: int in ROOM_CAPACITY:
+		var r_code: StringName = _columns_room_refusal(image, row)
+		if r_code != REFUSE_NONE:
+			return r_code
+	for row: int in FURNITURE_CAPACITY:
+		var f_code: StringName = _columns_furniture_refusal(image, row)
+		if f_code != REFUSE_NONE:
+			return f_code
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_flag_refusal(image: Columns) -> StringName:
+	"""COLUMN_FLAG for the first byte outside {0,1}, over all four flag buffers in fixed order.
+
+	This runs BEFORE any scalar row, so a malformed presence byte cannot be reported as a value
+	fault of the row it would otherwise decide.
+	"""
+	for row: int in BUILDING_CAPACITY:
+		if image.b_present[row] > 1:
+			return REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAG
+	for row: int in ROOM_CAPACITY:
+		if image.r_present[row] > 1:
+			return REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAG
+	for row: int in FURNITURE_CAPACITY:
+		if image.f_present[row] > 1:
+			return REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAG
+	for row: int in ROOM_CAPACITY:
+		if image.r_valid[row] > 1:
+			return REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAG
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_building_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""One building row's ordered gates: enum, value, reference, never-used, then state."""
+	var type_id: int = image.b_type_id[row]
+	var tier: int = image.b_tier[row]
+	if (type_id < 0 or type_id >= BuildingDefinitions.BUILDING_DEFINITION_COUNT
+			or tier < 0 or tier > BuildingDefinitions.TIER_TWO
+			or image.b_rotation[row] < 0 or image.b_rotation[row] >= ROTATION_COUNT
+			or image.b_state[row] < 0 or image.b_state[row] >= STATE_COUNT):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_ENUM
+	if (image.b_origin_tile[row] < NO_LINK or image.b_origin_tile[row] >= TILE_COUNT
+			or image.b_condition[row] < 0 or image.b_interior_id[row] < NO_INTERIOR):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_VALUE
+	if not _columns_ref_ok(image.b_construction_slot[row], image.b_construction_generation[row]):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_REF
+	if image.b_present[row] == 0 and tier == 0:
+		return _columns_building_free_refusal(image, row)
+	return _columns_building_state_refusal(image, row)
+
+
+static func _columns_building_free_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""A tier-0 inactive row must be exactly the clear row: never-used storage, not history."""
+	if (image.b_type_id[row] != 0 or image.b_origin_tile[row] != NO_LINK
+			or image.b_rotation[row] != 0 or image.b_state[row] != 0
+			or image.b_condition[row] != 0 or image.b_interior_id[row] != NO_INTERIOR
+			or image.b_construction_slot[row] != EntityDirectory.NULL_SLOT
+			or image.b_construction_generation[row] != EntityDirectory.NULL_GENERATION):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_FREE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_building_state_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""Every other row -- present, or inactive retained history -- must be a storable structure.
+
+	Tier 1 for any valid type, tier 2 only for the four upgradable ids, an origin on the grid and
+	a rotated footprint inside 128x128. A present tier-0 row has no such structure and refuses.
+	"""
+	var type_id: int = image.b_type_id[row]
+	var tier: int = image.b_tier[row]
+	if not (tier == BuildingDefinitions.MIN_TIER
+			or (tier == BuildingDefinitions.TIER_TWO and COLUMN_TIER_TWO_TYPE_IDS.has(type_id))):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_STATE
+	var origin: int = image.b_origin_tile[row]
+	if origin < 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_STATE
+	if not _columns_extent_fits(origin, COLUMN_BUILDING_FOOTPRINT_X[type_id],
+			COLUMN_BUILDING_FOOTPRINT_Z[type_id], image.b_rotation[row]):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_BUILDING_STATE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_room_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""One room row's ordered gates. Temperature permits the whole signed i32 domain, which its
+	packed type already enforces, so it has no gate of its own."""
+	if image.r_type[row] < 0 or image.r_type[row] >= ROOM_TYPE_COUNT:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_ENUM
+	if (image.r_tile_offset[row] < 0 or image.r_tile_offset[row] > ROOM_TILE_LINK_CAPACITY
+			or image.r_tile_count[row] < 0
+			or image.r_tile_count[row] > ROOM_TILE_LINK_CAPACITY
+			or image.r_furniture_mask[row] < 0
+			or image.r_furniture_mask[row] > (1 << FURNITURE_KIND_COUNT) - 1
+			or image.r_occupants[row] < 0
+			or image.r_occupants[row] > EntityDirectory.RESIDENT_LIVING_CAP):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_VALUE
+	if not _columns_ref_ok(image.r_building_slot[row], image.r_building_generation[row]):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_REF
+	if image.r_present[row] == 0:
+		return _columns_room_free_refusal(image, row)
+	return _columns_room_state_refusal(image, row)
+
+
+static func _columns_room_free_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""An inactive room clears span, mask and validity; with a NULL parent it is the exact
+	never-used row, and with a retained parent it keeps type, temperature and occupants."""
+	if (image.r_tile_offset[row] != 0 or image.r_tile_count[row] != 0
+			or image.r_furniture_mask[row] != 0 or image.r_valid[row] != 0):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_FREE
+	if not _columns_ref_is_null(image.r_building_slot[row], image.r_building_generation[row]):
+		return REFUSE_NONE
+	if (image.r_type[row] != 0 or image.r_temperature_tenths[row] != 0
+			or image.r_occupants[row] != 0):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_FREE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_room_state_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""A present room needs a nonnull parent and a span inside the arena. Validity is externally
+	supplied and is never derived here from furniture, heat, enclosure or access."""
+	if _columns_ref_is_null(image.r_building_slot[row], image.r_building_generation[row]):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_STATE
+	if (image.r_tile_count[row] < 1
+			or image.r_tile_offset[row] + image.r_tile_count[row] > ROOM_TILE_LINK_CAPACITY):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_ROOM_STATE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_furniture_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""One furniture row's ordered gates. Room and user are independent structural references;
+	neither is resolved, and neither implies anything about the other."""
+	if (image.f_type_id[row] < 0 or image.f_type_id[row] >= FURNITURE_KIND_COUNT
+			or image.f_rotation[row] < 0 or image.f_rotation[row] >= ROTATION_COUNT):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_ENUM
+	if (image.f_origin_tile[row] < NO_LINK or image.f_origin_tile[row] >= TILE_COUNT
+			or image.f_condition[row] < 0):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_VALUE
+	if (not _columns_ref_ok(image.f_room_slot[row], image.f_room_generation[row])
+			or not _columns_ref_ok(image.f_user_slot[row], image.f_user_generation[row])):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_REF
+	if image.f_present[row] == 0:
+		return _columns_furniture_free_refusal(image, row)
+	return _columns_furniture_state_refusal(image, row)
+
+
+static func _columns_furniture_free_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""An inactive piece has no user. With a NULL parent it must also be the exact never-used
+	row; with a retained parent it keeps its type, origin, rotation and condition."""
+	if not _columns_ref_is_null(image.f_user_slot[row], image.f_user_generation[row]):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_FREE
+	if not _columns_ref_is_null(image.f_room_slot[row], image.f_room_generation[row]):
+		return REFUSE_NONE
+	if (image.f_type_id[row] != 0 or image.f_origin_tile[row] != NO_LINK
+			or image.f_rotation[row] != 0 or image.f_condition[row] != 0):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_FREE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_furniture_state_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""A present piece needs a nonnull room, an on-grid origin and a floor footprint inside the
+	map. Edge furniture has a 0x0 floor footprint, claims no tile and is valid at any valid
+	origin; a user on a zero-user-slot kind is a policy question, not a storage fault."""
+	if _columns_ref_is_null(image.f_room_slot[row], image.f_room_generation[row]):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_STATE
+	var origin: int = image.f_origin_tile[row]
+	if origin < 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_STATE
+	var type_id: int = image.f_type_id[row]
+	var size_x: int = COLUMN_FURNITURE_FLOOR_X[type_id]
+	var size_z: int = COLUMN_FURNITURE_FLOOR_Z[type_id]
+	if size_x == 0 and size_z == 0:
+		return REFUSE_NONE
+	if not _columns_extent_fits(origin, size_x, size_z, image.f_rotation[row]):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_STATE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_extent_fits(origin_tile: int, size_x: int, size_z: int,
+		rotation: int) -> bool:
+	"""True when a rotated `size_x` by `size_z` extent at `origin_tile` stays inside 128x128.
+
+	Odd rotations exchange the two extents, and the tile bound is checked before any arithmetic.
+	"""
+	if origin_tile < 0 or origin_tile >= TILE_COUNT or size_x <= 0 or size_z <= 0:
+		return false
+	var extent_x: int = size_z if (rotation % 2) == 1 else size_x
+	var extent_z: int = size_x if (rotation % 2) == 1 else size_z
+	return (origin_tile % MAP_TILES_X + extent_x <= MAP_TILES_X
+		and origin_tile / MAP_TILES_X + extent_z <= MAP_TILES_Z)
+
+
+static func _columns_ref_is_null(slot: int, generation: int) -> bool:
+	"""True for exactly the GDD null reference (-1, 0), and for nothing else."""
+	return slot == EntityDirectory.NULL_SLOT and generation == EntityDirectory.NULL_GENERATION
+
+
+static func _columns_ref_ok(slot: int, generation: int) -> bool:
+	"""True for the exact null reference, or for a slot and generation that could name a row.
+
+	Structural only: the directory is not consulted, so this proves nothing about liveness."""
+	if _columns_ref_is_null(slot, generation):
+		return true
+	return slot >= 0 and slot < EntityDirectory.DIRECTORY_CAPACITY and generation >= 1
